## Activity

During June 2022, Oakridge Primary Care completed 58 captures. Activity was delivered in line with the expected site arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available records indicate that the site maintained service activity throughout the month. No additional operational issues were identified in the information provided.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally acceptable for the activity undertaken. There were 2 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 3.4. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing local image-capture practice. The result provides a basis for continued routine monitoring of image quality at Oakridge Primary Care.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 22 days. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside the referable results and image-quality findings, to support timely review and appropriate follow-up. Overall, the June 2022 activity shows completed service delivery with a small number of ungradable captures and referable results requiring attention.
